core_obligations: Identify the Cech groups (proof lines 1351-1355): using the description of Cech cohomology by maps from the sheaves represented by the fibre products, the author rewrites the groups as homomorphism groups subject to compatibility conditions.

Kill the higher groups (proof lines 1355-1358): injectivity of I allows the extension of the compatible families, so the positive degree groups vanish, and the degree zero group is I(U) by the same description.
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the Cech groups through the description by representable sheaves.
Use injectivity to extend compatible families and kill the positive degrees.
Read off the degree zero group.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Cech cohomology of an injective abelian sheaf with respect to an arbitrary covering of a site: it is I(U) in degree zero and vanishes in positive degrees (statement lines 1333-1349). The proof rewrites the groups by the description through representable sheaves (proof lines 1351-1355) and uses injactivity in the form of extendability of compatible families to kill the positive degrees (proof lines 1355-1358). The non-formal content is the extension argument. The claim is H2: one identification plus one extension argument.
